From the point C, which is due west of the tree, the angle of elevation of E, the top of the tree, is 60°. From the point D, which is 15 m due north of C, the angle of elevation of E is 30° (see Figure 2). The land on both sides of the river is flat and at the same level. Part (a): Use triangle ECT, to express |TE| in the form √a|CT| metres, where a ∈ ℕ. Part (c): Hence find |CT|, the distance from the base of the tree to the bank of the river at Conor’s side. Give your answer correct to 1 decimal place.
